description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects semicolon-WADL path suffixes beneath the IAM governance route.
affected_versions: Oracle Corporation Identity Manager: 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.2.1.0; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects semicolon-WADL path suffixes beneath the IAM governance route.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate clients using this unusual matrix suffix are denied.
